quotes.speaker: Kevin Quinn, TransLink CEO
statements: Car Free Day is a great opportunity to experience our communities in a different way and consider the many ways we can get around without a car.

We’re focused on making it easier for people to choose sustainable transportation — whether that’s taking transit, walking, cycling, or rolling — and are proud to support Burnaby’s Car Free Day once again.

quotes.speaker: Mike Hurley, Mayor of Burnaby
statements: We're thrilled to once again be hosting Car Free Day in Edmonds, one of the most vibrant neighbourhoods in Burnaby.
Last year's event was a celebration of community and sustainability, and we're so excited to be building on that again this year.
